blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Argument Mining (AM) transforms natural language into its underlying argument structures. This transformation is typically realized through a sequence of AM tasks that form an end-to-end AM pipeline. However, AM approaches often differ in how they conceptualize these tasks, making direct comparisons between them difficult and opaque. This calls for a more nuanced, task-level analysis of AM approaches to enable clearer comparison and assessment. This work presents a preliminary meta-study that systematically reviews several state-of-the-art end-to-end AM works and analyzes their pipelines through a triple-perspective framework—a linguistic, computational and domain perspective—to understand how the pipelines model arguments as structures, computes them, and integrates domain knowledge. We further propose a general design to the linguistic and computational perspectives, illustrating how key AM tasks are designed for modeling and computation of argument structures. Our proposed framework lays the groundwork for methodology-centered descriptions across AM approaches, facilitating deeper understanding and more systematic comparisons in future research.
blocks.zh: 辩证矿业(AM)将自然语言转化为其基础论证结构. 这种转变一般通过一系列构成端到端AM管道的AM任务实现. 然而,AM方法在对这些任务的构思上往往有所不同,使得它们之间的直接比较变得困难和不透明. 这就要求对AM方法进行更加细致、任务层次的分析,以便进行更明确的比较和评估。 这项工作提出了初步的元研究,系统地审查一些最新的端到端AM工作,并通过三视角框架——语言、计算和域视角——分析其管道,以了解管道如何将模型论点作为结构、计算和整合域知识。 我们进一步提出语言和计算角度的一般设计,说明如何设计关键AM任务,以建模和计算论证结构。 我们拟议的框架为以方法为中心的各种AM方法的描述奠定了基础,有助于在今后的研究中加深了解和更系统的比较。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Argument Mining (AM) is a sub-field of computational argumentation concerned with the automated transformation of natural language into structured argument representations [ 5 , 38 ] . Early work in AM typically concentrated on individual tasks—such as detecting argument units [ 65 , 39 ] or classifying argumentative relations [ 26 ] —reflecting the high costs of annotation and data collection in argumentation. While such single-task approaches have achieved strong performance [ 5 ] , they provide only a narrow and fragmented view of argumentative discourse. Recent advances in resource-efficient natural language processing (NLP) methods, coupled with the availability of large-scale corpora [ 36 ] , have shifted attention toward end-to-end AM approaches that cover the entire transformation process from raw discourse to complete argument structures [ 52 ] .
blocks.zh: 辩证矿业(AM)是计算论证的一个子领域,涉及自然语言自动转换为结构化论证表述[5,38]. AM的早期工作通常集中于个别任务——如探测论证单位[65,39]或对论证关系进行分类[26]——反映了论证中说明和数据收集的高成本。 虽然这种单一任务办法取得了强有力的业绩[5],但它们只提供了狭隘和零散的争论论观点。 资源效率高的自然语言处理方法(NLP)的近期进步,再加上大规模公司化[36]的可用性,使得注意力转向涵盖整个转变过程的端到端AM方法,从原始论述转向完整的论证结构[52].

blocks.en: This shift has also enabled AM to expand beyond single-purpose tasks and into a wide range of applications and research domains. Improvements in long-context reasoning and discourse modeling now make it feasible to generate argument structures from longer and more diverse texts. This has resulted in increased integration of AM not only in downstream NLP tasks—such as opinion mining [ 13 , 4 ] , stance classification [ 3 ] , fact-checking [ 68 ] , and quality assessment [ 17 , 30 ] —but also across a variety of research domains, including law [ 1 , 55 ] , political science and sociology [ 18 ] , bio-science [ 58 , 44 ] , and discourse analysis [ 24 ] . In parallel, practical applications of AM are also expanding, particularly in areas that require logical reasoning [ 30 ] , dialogical interaction [ 24 ] , and decision-making [ 7 ] . The increased attention on AM motivates closer investigation into how AM approaches are generally conceived and practiced across domains and applications.
blocks.zh: 这一转变还使AM能够超越单一目的的任务,扩展到广泛的应用和研究领域. 长文推理和论述模式的改进,使得从较长和更多样化的文本中产生论证结构成为可能。 这使得AM不仅在下游NLP任务——如意见挖掘[13,4],姿势分类[3],事实检查[68],质量评估[17,30]——中加强了整合,而且还涉及各种研究领域,包括法律[1,55],政治学和社会学[18],生物科学[58,44],以及言论分析[24]。 与此同时,AM的实际应用也在扩大,特别是在需要逻辑推理[30]、对话互动[24]和决策[7]的领域。 对AM的更多关注促使人们更加密切地调查AM方法如何在各个领域和应用中得到普遍构想和实践。

blocks.en: One common way to represent end-to-end AM is through high-level task representations that show how the transformation is operationalized. These representations, often referred to as argument mining pipelines [ 60 , 34 , 71 ] , outline the tasks involved and their arrangement, providing a system-level view of how discourse is transformed into structured arguments. Yet pipelines have typically been presented only at the level of listing tasks, without deeper examination of how those tasks are ordered, how they interact, or what role they play in the conceptualization of the AM process itself. Furthermore, the tasks themselves are not standardized, differing in name, functionality, and application. This highlights the need for a more systematic review of the pipelines—one that investigates not only which tasks are included, but also how they are organized and what role they serve in the AM pipeline.
blocks.zh: 代表端对端AM的一个常见方法是通过高级别任务说明,显示转型是如何运作的. 这些陈述,通常称为辩证采矿管道[60、34、71],概述了所涉任务及其安排,提供了一种系统层面的观点,说明如何将讨论转化为有条理的论点。 然而,通常只在列名任务一级提出管道,而没有更深入地审查这些任务是如何命令的、它们如何相互作用,或它们在AM进程本身的概念化方面发挥什么作用。 此外,这些任务本身没有标准化,名称、功能和应用各不相同。 这突出表明,有必要更系统地审查输油管——一个不仅调查哪些任务包含在内,而且调查如何组织这些任务,以及它们在AM输油管中发挥什么作用。

blocks.en: For this effort, we introduce the following working definition :
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出以下工作定义:

blocks.en: “An argument mining pipeline is an executable realization of an end-to-end argument mining that illustrates what tasks are required to transform raw discourse into a well-defined argument structure.”
blocks.zh: “一个论点的开采管道是可执行的端到端论点的开采,它说明需要哪些任务才能将原始的论述转变为定义明确的论据结构。 “

blocks.en: Analyzing Argument Mining (AM) pipelines is challenging not only because of the complexity of the subtasks required to construct argument structures, but also due to the inherently multidisciplinary nature of the field. AM operates at the intersection of three principal disciplines: argumentation theory, computational methods, and domain knowledge. Argumentation theory formulates the identification, extraction, and structuring of argumentative content in discourse, while computational methods enable the automation of these processes at scale. Domain knowledge, in turn, contextualizes argument structures and supports knowledge discovery from argumentative interactions. Building on prior work that conceptualizes AM as sequences of tasks [ 8 ] , we propose to reinterpret AM pipelines through a complementary, non-sequential lens organized around three core objectives: modeling, computation, and domain integration. Accordingly, our study analyzes AM pipelines using a triple-perspective approach:
blocks.zh: 分析辩证采矿(AM)管道具有挑战性,不仅因为建造辩证结构所需的子任务复杂,而且还因为实地固有的多学科性质。 AM运行于三个主要学科的交汇点:论证理论,计算方法,以及域知识. 辩证理论在论语中形成辩证内容的识别,提取,和结构,而计算方法则使得这些过程在规模上能够自动化. 域知识反过来又将论证结构背景化,支持通过论证性互动发现知识. 在将AM概念化为一系列任务[8]的先前工作的基础上,我们提议通过围绕三个核心目标(建模、计算和域集成)的互补、非序列镜头重新解释AM管道。 因此,我们的研究用三重视角分析AM管道:

blocks.en: • the linguistic perspective , how pipelines conceptualize and represent argument structures; • the computational perspective , how pipelines automate and compute argument structures; and • the domain perspective , how pipelines integrate domain knowledge into its design and application.
blocks.zh: • 语言视角,管道如何构思和代表论证结构;

blocks.en: the linguistic perspective , how pipelines conceptualize and represent argument structures;
blocks.zh: 语言角度,管道如何构思和代表论证结构;

blocks.en: the computational perspective , how pipelines automate and compute argument structures; and
blocks.zh: 计算角度,管道如何自动化和计算参数结构;以及

blocks.en: the domain perspective , how pipelines integrate domain knowledge into its design and application.
blocks.zh: 以及管道如何将域知识纳入其设计和应用。

blocks.en: Using this framework, we conduct a systematic review of representative end-to-end AM approaches, identifying core design choices and patterns in how argument structures are modeled, computed, and contextualized. Our goal is to provide a macro-level analytical basis for understanding and comparing contemporary AM pipelines.
blocks.zh: 我们利用这一框架,对有代表性的端对端AM方法进行系统审查,确定核心设计选择和论证结构的模型、计算和背景化模式。 我们的目标是为理解和比较当代AM管道提供宏观分析基础。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing meta-level surveys on Argument Mining (AM) have primarily organized the field around datasets [ 10 , 40 ] , task taxonomies [ 32 ] , or application domains [ 67 ] . While these works have been instrumental in mapping the development of AM, they typically examine individual dimensions of the field rather than the design of complete pipelines.
blocks.zh: 现有关于辩证采矿的元级调查主要围绕数据集[10、40]、任务分类[32]或应用域[67]组织实地。 虽然这些作品有助于绘制AM的发展图,但它们通常审查实地的各个层面,而不是设计完整的管道。

blocks.en: In practice, AM operates as a structured process that transforms raw discourse into argument representations composed of argument units (e.g., claims, premises) connected by argument relations (e.g., support, attack). This transformation is realized through AM pipelines, whose design choices—such as how tasks are defined, ordered, and integrated—directly affect system behavior, interpretability and applicability. Despite this central role, there has been limited standardized macro-level analysis of how pipelines are designed or how their methodological choices can be systematically compared. As a result, the conceptual, computational, and contextual dimensions of AM systems are often evaluated in isolation.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,AM是一个结构化的过程,将原始的论述转变为由论证关系(如支持,攻击)相连的论证单位(如诉求,前提)组成的论证表述. 这种转变是通过AM管道实现的,其设计选择——如任务如何界定、命令和综合——直接影响系统行为、解释性和适用性。 尽管发挥这一中心作用,但关于如何设计管道或如何系统地比较其方法选择的标准化宏观分析有限。 因此,AM系统的概念、计算和背景层面往往被孤立地评估。

blocks.en: Earlier efforts have partially acknowledged this. For example, Budzynska and Villata [8] distinguished between linguistic modeling and computational realization of argument structures, framing AM as a process of resource construction followed by automation. However, pipeline designs have become increasingly diverse, expanding both the linguistic modeling and the computational landscape. A shift from predominantly theory-driven modeling toward more data-driven approaches is evident, accompanied by rapid advances in neural and language modeling techniques. Joint neural architectures now integrate unit detection and relation classification within shared representations [ 15 , 47 ] ; knowledge-enriched systems incorporate discourse cues and domain ontologies [ 2 , 25 ] ; and recent LLM-based methods collapse traditional modular pipelines into unified prompting frameworks [ 19 , 27 ] . This heterogeneity further complicates systematic comparison and highlights the absence of a unified analytical lens.
blocks.zh: 先前的努力在一定程度上确认了这一点。 例如,Budzynska和Villata[8]区分了语言模型和论证结构的计算实现,将AM设定为资源构建的过程,然后是自动化. 然而,管道设计越来越多样化,扩大了语言模型和计算景观。 明显从以理论为主的模型转向以数据为主的方法,伴随神经和语言模型技术的迅速进步。 联合神经架构现在将单位检测和关系分类纳入共享表达法[15,47];知识丰富的系统包括话语提示和域本体论[2,25];最近基于LLM的方法将传统的模块化管道崩溃为统一的提示框架[19,27]. 这种异质性使系统比较进一步复杂化,凸显出缺乏统一的分析镜头.

blocks.en: In this work, we address this gap by proposing a macro-level, triple-perspective framework that systematically examines how end-to-end AM pipelines model, compute, and contextualize argument structures across domains.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们通过提出一个宏观层面的三重展望框架来解决这一差距,这一框架将系统地审查端到端AM管道模型、计算和背景化各领域的论据结构。

blocks.en: 3 Selection of Relevant Literature
blocks.zh: 3 相关文献选编.

blocks.en: To conduct our systematic review of end-to-end AM pipelines, we retrieved potentially relevant literature from two major research databases: SCOPUS 1 1 1 https://www.scopus.com/ and Web of Science (WoS) 2 2 2 https://www.webofscience.com/ . Because the term pipeline is not consistently used in AM, our search queries also included related terms such as argument unit, extraction, detection, relation, support, and attack. The initial search returned 273 records from SCOPUS and 237 from Web of Science. After merging and removing duplicates based on title and abstract, we obtained 384 documents, referred to as the Argument Mining Pipelines original set (AMP384).
blocks.zh: 为了对端对端的AM管道进行系统审查,我们从两个主要研究数据库中检索了潜在的相关文献:SCOPUS 1 1 1 https://www.scopus.com/和Web of Science(WOS) 2 2 https://www.webofscience.com/。 因为管道一词在AM中并不一致使用,所以我们的搜索查询还包括了相关术语,如参数单元,提取,检测,关系,支持,以及攻击. 最初的搜索返回了来自SCOPUS的273张记录和来自科学网的237张记录. 在根据标题和抽象合并和删除复制品后,我们获得了384份文件,称为"辩证采矿管道原版集"(AMP384)。

blocks.en: Next we defined the following selection criteria to identify the relevant literature:
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们确定了以下选择标准,以确定相关文献:

blocks.en: 1. The document must explicitly discuss the AM process with intent to produce argument structures, whole or part. 2. The tasks involved in transformation process must be identifiable. 3. Its input data and output argument structure must be identifiable. 4. The document should preferably be open-access for detailed analysis of its methodology, data and evaluation strategy.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 文件必须明确讨论AM进程,以产生全部或部分的论据结构。 2. 改革进程所涉任务必须能够确定。 3. 其输入数据和输出参数结构必须可以识别。 4. 文件最好可以公开查阅,以便详细分析其方法、数据和评价战略。

blocks.en: The document must explicitly discuss the AM process with intent to produce argument structures, whole or part.
blocks.zh: 文件必须明确讨论AM进程,以产生全部或部分的论据结构。

blocks.en: The tasks involved in transformation process must be identifiable.
blocks.zh: 改革进程所涉任务必须能够确定。

blocks.en: Its input data and output argument structure must be identifiable.
blocks.zh: 它的输入数据和输出参数结构必须可以识别.

blocks.en: The document should preferably be open-access for detailed analysis of its methodology, data and evaluation strategy.
blocks.zh: 该文件最好可以公开查阅,详细分析其方法、数据和评价战略。

blocks.en: We employed GPT-4 to assist with abstract-level screening by providing a structured prompt with a set of questions based on the predefined selection criteria and the triple-perspective framework, described in the next section, and instructing it to return “unknown” where information was not explicitly stated. Based on its responses, we shortlisted 164 studies that most closely satisfied the criteria, forming the Argument Mining Pipelines 164 dataset (AMP164). Inclusion in AMP164 does not imply that every study fully meets all selection criteria; rather, the dataset comprises works that positively answered most questions. The complete list of documents and additional documentation of the selection process are available on our public repository 3 3 3 https://github.com/The-obsrvr/ArgumentMiningPipelines .
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-4来协助抽象一级的筛选,方法是提供一套结构化的即时检查,根据预定义的选择标准和下一节所述的三重展望框架提出一系列问题,并指示它返回“未知”的信息没有明确说明的地方。 根据答复,我们选出了164项研究,这些研究最符合标准,组成了辩证采矿管道164数据集(AMP164)。 AMP164中的包含并不意味着每一项研究都完全符合所有选择标准;相反,数据集包含积极回答大多数问题的作品. 我们的公开存放处3 3 https://github.com/The-obsrvr/ArgumentMiningPipelines提供了甄选过程的全部文件和补充文件。

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows the yearly distribution of AMP164, indicating a rising shift toward end-to-end AM research. It also summarizes the principal application domains identified in our analysis: six domains were explicitly defined based on thematic grouping, while remaining studies were categorized under a default “others" label when domain information was unclear. The distribution indicates a strong interest in domains characterized by multi-stance and deliberative discourse, including debates, essays, and social media.
blocks.zh: 图1显示AMP164的年分布,表明向端到端AM研究的转变正在上升。 报告还总结了我们分析中确定的主要应用领域:六个领域是根据主题分组明确界定的,而其余的研究则在域信息不明确时被划入默认的“其他”标签。 分布表明,人们非常关注以多姿多彩和讨论为特点的领域,包括辩论、散文和社交媒体。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Distribution of the documents in the AMP164 underscoring the growth in AM pipelines over the last two decades (up to June 2025), further split against the principal domain in which the work lies.
blocks.zh: 图1:AMP164文件的分发,强调过去20年(截至2025年6月)AM管道的增长,与工作的主要领域进一步分割。

blocks.en: In the following section, we present the main findings derived from analyzing AMP164 manually through our triple-perspective framework.
blocks.zh: 在下一节中,我们介绍通过我们三视角框架手动分析AMP164得出的主要结论。

blocks.en: 4 Triple-perspective Framework
blocks.zh: 4 三视角框架

blocks.en: To apply our triple-perspective framework to the selected literature, we analyzed the principal design choices underlying AM pipelines from each respective lens. The linguistic and computational perspectives are examined through an investigative review, with findings and generalized representations of their core tasks and design choices presented in Sections 4.1 and 4.2 . The analysis is then extended to the domain perspective in Section 4.3 , where we examine how domain knowledge influences pipeline design and operational processes.
blocks.zh: 为了将我们的三视角框架应用于选定的文献,我们从每个角度分析了AM管道的主要设计选择。 通过调查审查语言和计算观点,并在第4.1和4.2节中阐述调查结果和对其核心任务和设计选择的一般表述。 然后,分析扩大到第4.3节的域视角,我们在该节中审查域知识如何影响管道设计和操作程序。

blocks.en: 4.1 Linguistic Perspective
blocks.zh: 4.1 语言视角

blocks.en: Linguistic perspective focuses on how the argument structure is conceptualized and modeled by the AM pipeline. The structure modeling can be seen as the product of conceptualizing, framing, and applying principles from argumentation theory in conjunction with linguistic principles to generate formal representations of argument structures. For a systematic evaluation of the linguistic perspective, we defined a set of guiding questions and applied them to our selected literature:
blocks.zh: 语言视角侧重于论证结构是如何由AM管道概念化和模型化的. 结构建模可视为概念化,框架化,以及结合语言学原理应用论证理论原理生成论证结构的正式表述的产物. 为了系统地评估语言学观点,我们界定了一套指导性问题,并将其应用于我们选定的文献:

blocks.en: 1. What are the core argumentation theory and/or linguistic principles used in the structure modeling? 2. How has the argument and its structure been formalized? 3. How has the data resource, if any, been produced?
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 结构建模中使用的核心论证理论和/或语言学原理是什么? 2. 这一论点及其结构是如何正式化的? 3. 数据资源(如有)是如何生产的?

blocks.en: What are the core argumentation theory and/or linguistic principles used in the structure modeling?
blocks.zh: 结构建模中使用的核心论证理论和/或语言学原理是什么?

blocks.en: How has the argument and its structure been formalized?
blocks.zh: 这一论点及其结构是如何正式确定的?

blocks.en: How has the data resource, if any, been produced?
blocks.zh: 数据资源(如果有)是如何生产的?

blocks.en: Our review indicates that structure modeling is typically realized through two primary methodologies: theory-driven and data-driven .
blocks.zh: 我们的审查表明,结构建模通常是通过两种主要方法实现的:理论驱动和数据驱动。

blocks.en: Theory-driven approaches adopt established argumentation frameworks, most prominently Toulmin-inspired models [ 29 ] and Walton’s taxonomy of argument schemes [ 70 ] . These frameworks provide predefined categories and relational structures that aid in the identification of argumentative units and their interactions [ 45 ] . In contrast, data-driven approaches derive argument structures using indicators from the discourse, such as argumentative discourse markers [ 48 , 33 ] , context [ 50 ] , or interactional patterns [ 43 ] . Rather than strictly adhering to predefined theoretical taxonomies, these methods infer structure from linguistic signals and contextual prompts present in the data. While offering greater flexibility and adaptability to real-world discourse, data-driven methods may introduce interpretative variability due to the absence of a fixed theoretical foundation. Modern works are combining the two approaches in a hybrid methodology, where discourse markers are used to identify empirically arguments in the discourse which are then justified using existing theoretical foundations.
blocks.zh: 理论驱动的方法采用了既定的论证框架,最突出的是Toulmin启发的模型[29]和Walton的论证计划分类[70]。 这些框架提供了预先界定的类别和关系结构,有助于确定论证单位及其相互作用[45]。 与此相对照,数据驱动的方法利用论述中的指标来得出论证结构,如论证性论述标记[48,33],上下文[50],或交互规律[43]. 这些方法并非严格遵循预先定义的理论分类法,而是从语言信号和数据中的背景提示推断结构。 数据驱动的方法虽然为现实世界的论述提供了更大的灵活性和适应性,但由于缺乏固定的理论基础,可能引入解释性变异性. 现代著作正在混合方法中将两种方法结合起来,在混合方法中,使用论述标记来鉴定讨论中的经验性论点,然后利用现有理论基础证明这些论点是合理的。

blocks.en: Beyond methodological orientation, modeling decisions can also be examined across two analytical levels: the micro-level and the macro-level .
blocks.zh: 除了方法导向之外,还可以从两个分析层面审查建模决定:微观层面和宏观层面。

blocks.en: At the micro-level, pipelines identify and segment argumentative units within discourse, distinguishing them from non-argumentative segments. Units vary in granularity, ranging from token- or span-level representations [ 28 , 63 ] to sentence-level classifications [ 22 ] . They may further be categorized through argument component classification [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 在微观一级,管道在论述中确定和分解论证单位,将它们与非论证性部分区分开来. 单位在颗粒度上各不相同,从符号级或跨度级表示[28,63]到句子级分类[22]. 可通过论据部分分类进一步分类。

blocks.en: At the macro-level, modeling concerns the relational structure connecting argumentative units. Pipelines define and classify relations such as support, attack, rephrasing [ 53 ] , agreement or disagreement with respect to a proposition [ 26 ] , or broader dialogical functions such as questioning, justification, acknowledgment, or summarization [ 45 , 16 , 66 ] .
blocks.zh: 在宏观层面,建模涉及连接辩证单位的关系结构. 管道定义和分类关系,如支持、攻击、重写[53]、对一项命题的一致或不同意见[26],或更广泛的对话功能,如询问、说明、承认或概括[45、16、66]。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of the key design choices made within the linguistic modeling component of the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 图2:管道语言模型部分内作出的关键设计选择概述.

blocks.en: The modeling choices are ultimately formalized in concrete resources—such as argumentation grammars and annotated corpora [ 35 ] —which shape how argumentative content is identified, structured, and replicated by the pipeline. Annotated corpora, in particular, play a central role: they both operationalize theoretical schemes in practice and provide reusable resources for downstream tasks such as pipeline automation and discourse analysis.
blocks.zh: 模型选择最终正式化为具体资源——如论证语法和注解的corpora[35]——决定了论证内容如何被确定、结构化和由管道复制。 特别是附加说明的公司公司发挥着中心作用:它们既在实践中实施理论计划,又为管道自动化和言论分析等下游任务提供可重复使用的资源。

blocks.en: Corpus creation initiates with selecting appropriate data sources and pre-processing them according to predefined assumptions and constraints, often inferred from domain. The modeling framework is then applied through a structured annotation study, which specifies annotator roles, annotation platforms, and detailed guidelines [ 69 ] . Annotation quality is assessed using inter-annotator agreement metrics, after which annotations are aggregated—commonly through majority voting—to establish a gold standard. Disagreements or inconclusive cases are resolved through revision procedures [ 46 ] . This remains one of the most labor-intensive components of AM pipelines. (see also [ 46 , 35 , 38 ] ).
blocks.zh: Corpus创建启动时会选择适当的数据源,并根据预先确定的假设和制约进行预处理,这些假设和制约往往从域中推断出来. 然后通过结构化的注释研究来应用模型框架,该研究具体规定了注释者的角色,注释平台,以及详细的指南[69]. 对说明质量的评估采用说明人之间协议的衡量标准,然后将说明加以汇总——通常通过多数表决——以确立金本位。 分歧或无定论的案件通过审校程序解决. [46]. 这仍然是AM管道中劳动最密集的组成部分之一. (另见[46、35、38]。)

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the general modeling processes and their key design choices inferred from this perspective. Examining structure modeling in this way potentially clarifies the theoretical assumptions made in the AM pipelines and highlights the associated resource costs in terms of data and human labor. It also reveals how modeling choices are often domain-sensitive, with annotation schemes and corpora differing substantially across legal, political, and other domains. In the following sections, we examine how these modeling decisions interact with computational and domain considerations.
blocks.zh: 图2概述了从这一角度推断的一般建模过程及其关键设计选择。 以这种方式审查结构模型可能澄清在AM管道中所作的理论假设,并突出数据和人力方面的相关资源成本。 它还揭示了建模选择如何往往对领域有敏感认识,在法律、政治及其他领域,说明计划和公司差别很大。 在以下各节中,我们审视这些建模决定如何与计算和领域考虑相互作用。

blocks.en: 4.2 Computational Perspective
blocks.zh: 4.2 计算视角

blocks.en: The computational perspective focuses on how argument structures are operationalized and automated at scale through computational methods. To study this systematically, we formulated the following guiding questions on our selected literature:
blocks.zh: 计算视角侧重于论证结构如何通过计算方法在规模上运作和自动化. 为了系统地研究这一点,我们针对我们选定的文献提出了以下指导性问题:

blocks.en: 1. What are the main AM tasks automated in the work? 2. How are the identified AM tasks implemented computationally? 3. For each computational model of a task, what are their input and output requirements? 4. How has each identified computational model been developed and evaluated?
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 工作自动化的AM主要任务是什么? 2. 如何通过计算执行已确定的AM任务? 3. 对于一项任务的每个计算模型,其投入和产出要求是什么? 4. 如何制定和评价每一个确定的计算模型?

blocks.en: What are the main AM tasks automated in the work?
blocks.zh: 工作自动化的AM主要任务是什么?

blocks.en: How are the identified AM tasks implemented computationally?
blocks.zh: 如何在计算中执行已确定的AM任务?

blocks.en: For each computational model of a task, what are their input and output requirements?
blocks.zh: 对于一项任务的每个计算模型,其投入和产出要求是什么?

blocks.en: How has each identified computational model been developed and evaluated?
blocks.zh: 如何制定和评价每一个确定的计算模型?

blocks.en: Our review established two core design choices in the literature: (i) the modeling paradigm employed for automation, and (ii) the architecture and decomposition of tasks within the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们的审查在文献中确定了两个核心设计选择:(一) 自动化所用的模型模式;(二) 管道内各项任务的架构和分解。

blocks.en:
Modeling paradigms. Argument structures are computed through three broad paradigms:
(i) feature-based approaches , including discourse marker identification and manual feature engineering;
(ii) deep learning models , particularly neural architectures and transformer-based systems; and
(iii) large language models (LLMs) adapted to argumentation tasks, often in generative or instruction-tuned settings.

Feature-based approaches [ 14 , 23 , 57 ] rely on explicit linguistic, syntactic, and discourse-level features derived from the underlying modeling framework and data. These approaches offer interpretability and close alignment with theoretical foundations but are limited in their scope and generalizability.
blocks.zh: 基于特征的方法[14、23、57]依靠从基本模型框架和数据中得出的明确的语言、综合和论述层面特征。 这些方法提供了可解释性和与理论基础的密切配合,但其范围和普遍性有限。

blocks.en: Deep learning approaches [ 62 , 42 ] reduce dependence on handcrafted features by learning distributed representations directly from annotated data. Fine-tuned transformer models have become dominant in tasks such as argument component identification and relation classification, offering improved generalization and scalability.
blocks.zh: 深层学习方法[62,42]通过直接从附加说明的数据中学习分布式表述,减少对手工特征的依赖. 微调变压器模型在论证成分识别和关系分类等任务中占据主导地位,提供了更好的概括性和可扩展性.

blocks.en: More recently, LLM-based approaches [ 9 , 12 , 49 ] adapt AM tasks as generative or instruction-following problems, producing structured argument representations directly from raw discourse. While these models demonstrate flexibility and cross-task transfer, they introduce challenges related to output controllability, evaluation, interpretability, and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 最近,基于LLM的方法[9、12、49]将AM任务作为基因问题或指导问题加以调整,直接从原始论述中产生结构化的论证。 虽然这些模型表现出灵活性和跨任务转移,但它们带来了与产出可控性、评价、可解释性和计算成本有关的挑战。

blocks.en: Across the literature, there is a clear shift from feature-engineered approaches toward increasingly data-intensive neural approaches, driven by improvements in computational resources and data availability.
blocks.zh: 在整个文献中,由于计算资源和数据提供情况的改善,从专题设计的方法明显转向数据密集程度越来越高的神经方法。

blocks.en:
Task architecture and decomposition .
Pipelines differ in how argument structure prediction is decomposed into computational steps. To facilitate systematic comparison, we conceptualize each computational component as an input–output (I/O) unit : a modular element that receives structured input, processes it using a defined model, and produces a specified output. This abstraction allows heterogeneous pipelines to be analyzed within a unified framework.
blocks.zh:
任务架构与分解.
管道在论证结构预测如何分解成计算步骤上有所不同. 为了便于系统比较,我们把每个计算组件概念化为输入-输出(I/O)单元:一个模块元素,接收结构化输入,使用定义的模型进行处理,并产生指定的输出. 这种抽象使得各种管道能够在一个统一的框架中进行分析。

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 3 , an I/O unit typically begins with input formatting, determined by (i) the AM task (e.g., extraction, classification, relation identification), (ii) the granularity of representation, and (iii) the learning strategy (the modeling paradigm). The formatted input is processed by the task-specific model, which optionally may require training and optimization. Predictions may then undergo post-processing to integrate intermediate outputs into a coherent argument structure.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,I/O单元一般以输入格式为起点,由下列因素确定:(一) AM任务(如提取、分类、关系识别);(二) 代表的颗粒性;(三) 学习战略(模式)。 格式化输入由任务特定模式处理,可选择可能需要培训和优化。 然后可以进行后处理,将中间产出纳入一个连贯的论证结构。

blocks.en: Based on their decomposition strategy, AM pipelines generally adopt either a multi-step design or a single-step ‘unified’ design . Multi-step architectures generate intermediate representations through sequential I/O units [ 62 , 63 ] , enabling modular evaluation and interpretability. However, they require additional engineering effort and task-specific supervision. In contrast, single-step architectures aim to produce complete argument structures directly from raw input [ 14 , 64 ] . While potentially less transparent, these approaches exploit cross-task dependencies and require relatively lesser computational resources.
blocks.zh: 根据分解战略,AM管道一般采用多步设计或单步 " 统一 " 设计。 多步骤架构通过相继的I/O单位[62,63]产生中间表示,使模块评价和可解释性得以实现. 然而,它们需要更多的工程努力和具体任务的监督。 相反,单步架构旨在直接从原始输入产生完整的论证结构[14,64]. 这些方法虽然可能不太透明,但利用跨任务的依赖性,需要相对较少的计算资源。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Overview of the key design choices made within the computational component of the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 图3:管道计算部分内作出的主要设计选择概述。

blocks.en: Together, these two choices—modeling paradigm and task decomposition—capture the principal computational design choices observed across the AM pipelines.
blocks.zh: 这两项选择——建模模式和任务分解——合在一起抓住了在整个AM管道中观察到的主要计算设计选择。

blocks.en: 4.3 Domain Perspective
blocks.zh: 4.3 领域视角

blocks.en: The linguistic and computational perspectives highlight how argument structures are modeled and automated. However, a comprehensive assessment of AM pipelines also requires examining how they engage with domain knowledge [ 31 ] . Domain influences pipelines in two complementary ways: it shapes modeling and computational choices, and it determines how extracted argument structures are interpreted or applied.
blocks.zh: 语言学和计算学视角突出论证结构如何建模和自动化. 然而,对AM管道的全面评估也需要审查这些管道如何利用域知识[31]。 域以两种互补的方式影响管道:它塑造模型和计算选择,它决定如何解释或应用提取的论证结构.

blocks.en: In this context, domain refers to the discourse setting and knowledge structures underlying the data—its genre, conventions, terminology, and ontological assumptions—which influence how arguments are expressed and understood [ 31 ] . Domains may be limited in scope (e.g., classroom discussions or single conversations) or broad and discipline-level (e.g., legal, financial, political, biomedical). Each introduces specific knowledge requirements ranging from commonsense assumptions to highly specialized expertise.
blocks.zh: 在这方面,域指数据所依据的论述设置和知识结构——其流派、惯例、术语和本体学假设——影响论点的表达和理解[31]。 领域可能范围有限(如课堂讨论或单一对话)或范围广泛和学科层面(如法律,金融,政治,生物医学). 每种技术都引入了从常识假设到高度专业知识的具体知识要求。

blocks.en: The domain perspective examines both the forms of knowledge integrated into AM pipelines and the mechanisms through which they influence modeling assumptions, computational strategies, and evaluation criteria. As reflected in Figure 1 , the AMP164 data spans diverse domains, particularly those characterized by deliberation and multi-stance discourse, such as debates, politics, social media, and healthcare.
blocks.zh: 领域视角既审查纳入AM管道的知识形式,也审查影响模型假设、计算战略和评价标准的机制。 如图1所示,AMP164数据涵盖多个领域,特别是辩论、政治、社交媒体和保健等以讨论和多党对话为特点的领域。

blocks.en: (1) Schema Design. Domain knowledge directly constrains how argument units and relations are defined. Terminology, ontologies, and discourse conventions determine what qualifies as a claim or premise and which relations—such as support or attack—are meaningful. For example, ontology-guided approaches have been applied in biomedical, financial and legal contexts [ 58 , 1 , 37 ] , while broader commonsense or factual knowledge can shape relation classification [ 6 , 26 ] . As a result, annotation schemas and modeling assumptions often vary substantially across domains.
blocks.zh: (1)司马设计. 域知识直接制约了参数单位和关系的定义. 术语、本体学和论述公约确定什么是主张或前提,哪些关系——如支持或攻击——是有意义的。 例如,在生物医学、金融和法律方面应用了本体学指导方法[58、1、37],而更广泛的常识或事实知识可以形成关系分类[6、26]。 因此,注解计划和建模假设在不同领域之间往往有很大差异。

blocks.en: (2) Computational Modeling and Application. Domain knowledge also guides how argument structures are computed and subsequently used. Structured representations can support downstream tasks such as stance analysis [ 51 ] , implicit reasoning detection [ 56 , 61 ] , debate outcome prediction [ 21 ] , and fallacy identification [ 41 , 54 ] . In such cases, argument structures function not only as intermediate representations but also as analytical tools for domain-specific knowledge discovery.
blocks.zh: (2)计算模型与应用. 域知识还指导如何计算和随后使用参数结构。 结构化表述可以支持下游任务,如姿态分析[51],隐含推理检测[56,61],辩论结果预测[21],以及谬误识别[41,54]. 在这种情况下,论证结构不仅作为中间表述,而且作为特定领域知识发现的分析工具。

blocks.en: (3) Evaluation and Post-processing Strategies. Finally, domain also affects the evaluation practices adopted in the pipeline. Performance must be assessed not only by predictive accuracy but also by how well extracted structures capture domain-specific reasoning norms and patterns. Specialized domains such as law, finance, or biomedicine require evaluation criteria aligned with domain standards [ 20 , 1 , 59 , 37 ] . In contrast, political and social domains may require sensitivity to stance diversity, implicit reasoning, and potentially offensive or sensitive content. Domain knowledge could further guide post-processing decisions, such as enforcing structural constraints, filtering implausible relations, or validating outputs against ontologies and expert rules.
blocks.zh: (3) 评价和后处理战略。 最后,域也影响到在编审过程中采用的评价做法。 业绩评估不仅要通过预测准确性,还要通过提取的结构如何很好地捕捉特定领域推理规范和模式。 法律、金融或生物医学等专门领域要求符合域标准的评价标准[20、1、59、37]。 与此相反,政治和社会领域可能需要对立场多样性的敏感性、隐含的推理以及潜在的冒犯性或敏感的内容。 域知识可以进一步指导处理后的决定,例如执行结构限制,过滤不可信的关系,或对照本体学和专家规则验证产出。

blocks.en: Overall, incorporating the domain perspective clarifies how AM pipelines are situated within specific discourse contexts and highlights the conditions under which modeling and computational choices remain valid and accurate. A more systematic treatment of domain interaction remains an important direction for future research, particularly for improving transferability of argument resources across contexts.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,纳入域视角可澄清AM管道如何在具体讨论背景下定位,并突出模型和计算选择仍然有效和准确的条件。 更系统地处理域间相互作用仍然是今后研究的一个重要方向,特别是为了改善各种背景的论证资源的可转让性。

blocks.en: 5 Significance of Pipeline Comparison
blocks.zh: 5 管道比较的意义

blocks.en: The previous sections examined AM pipelines through a multi-perspective lens, revealing substantial variation in pipeline design choices. Considering these dimensions collectively offers a more systematic basis for comparing pipeline designs. Rather than viewing pipelines solely as modular sequences of tasks, the framework encourages analysis of how linguistic, computational, and domain-related design choices interact within a system. This framework supports three analytical benefits:
blocks.zh: 前几节通过多透镜检查AM管道,揭示了管道设计选择的巨大差异. 综合考虑这些方面为比较管道设计提供了一个更系统的基础。 框架不只将管道视为任务的模块化序列,而是鼓励分析语言、计算和与域有关的设计选择如何在系统内相互作用。 这个框架支持三个分析效益:

blocks.en: (1) Pipeline-level characterization. Pipelines can be grouped according to shared methodological features—such as on their level of task decomposition, modeling paradigm adopted, structure modeling choices—enabling better benchmarking and resource-sharing between them.
blocks.zh: (1)管道级特征. 管道可以按照共同的方法特征加以分类,例如,其任务分解程度、所采用的模式模型、结构模型选择等,从而能够更好地制定基准和在它们之间分享资源。

blocks.en: (2) Clarification of methodological dependencies. The framework highlights how decisions in modeling, computation, and domain integration influence one another. Making these dependencies explicit supports more transparent interpretation of pipeline behavior and its reproduction.
blocks.zh: (2) 澄清方法依赖性。 该框架强调在建模、计算和域整合方面的决定如何相互影响。 明确这些依赖性有助于更透明地解释管道行为及其复制。

blocks.en: (3) Systematic comparison of pipelines. By assessing the pipelines through the same analytical framework, we enables comparison beyond performance metrics or architectural choices. Approaches with similar results may differ in their theoretical grounding, task decomposition, or domain integration.
blocks.zh: (3)系统比较管道. 通过同样的分析框架对管道进行评估,我们就能够进行比较,超越业绩计量或建筑选择。 具有类似结果的方法在理论基础、任务分解或域整合方面可能有所不同。

blocks.en: Overall, a holistic assessment visualizes AM pipelines not as sequences of independent tasks but as dynamic, methodological configurations whose linguistic, computational, and domain characteristics jointly determine their behavior, scope and application. Such a perspective supports clearer comparison and contributes to a more structured understanding of the evolving landscape of end-to-end AM systems.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,整体评估将AM管道不作为独立任务的序列,而是作为动态和方法配置,其语言、计算和域特征共同决定其行为、范围和应用。 这种观点有助于更明确地进行比较,并有助于更系统地了解端到端AM系统不断变化的情况。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This study examined AM through the lens of end-to-end pipelines, focusing on how argument structures are modeled, computed, and contextualized within a domain. Using a triple-perspective framework—linguistic, computational, and domain—we conducted a structured review of representative AM systems to identify core design choices and analyzed how these choices shape pipeline behavior.
blocks.zh: 这项研究通过端到端管道的透镜审查了AM,重点是论证结构是如何在一个领域内进行模型化、计算和背景化的。 我们利用三重视角框架——语言、计算和领域——对有代表性的AM系统进行了分阶段审查,以确定核心设计选择,并分析这些选择如何形成管道行为。

blocks.en: Our findings indicate a shift toward more structured and hybrid configurations that move beyond isolated subtasks. Modeling assumptions, computational strategies, and domain requirements emerge as interdependent factors that jointly shape pipeline behavior and applicability. Recognizing these interactions is essential for developing adaptable and methodologically transparent AM systems.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,正在转向结构更加合理和混合的配置,超越孤立的子任务。 建模假设,计算策略,以及域要求,都是相互依存的因素,共同形成管道行为和适用性. 承认这些相互作用对于发展适应性强、方法透明的AM系统至关重要。

blocks.en: While this work provides a macro-level perspective on pipeline design, it is limited in its depth of analysis. Each perspective and its design choices require deeper investigation. Future research should further refine and align modeling, computation, and domain integration to support resource reuse, cross-domain transfer, and more coherent evaluation. Advancing in this direction will help build AM pipelines that are robust, reproducible, and better suited to real-world discourse analysis.
blocks.zh: 虽然这项工作为管道设计提供了宏观视角,但其分析深度有限。 每一种观点及其设计选择都需要更深入的调查。 未来的研究应进一步完善和调整模型、计算和域整合,以支持资源再利用、跨域转移和更协调一致的评价。 朝这个方向前进将有助于建立坚实、可复制、更适合现实世界言论分析的AM管道。
